connector.name: Respira WordPress MCP by webmyc
connector.registryDescription: WordPress MCP 2026-07-28 with legacy clients, 17 page builders, Site Editor and WooCommerce.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package wordpress-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the webmyc account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
